translation: The jaw (夾車) is the hook bone below the ear gate (耳門). Once this place is opened, there is no obstruction inside or outside, above or below. Its accumulation attaches beside the neck bone, and stops in the shoulders, back, flanks, ribs, waist, hips, legs, and feet; seen externally it is slightly thick, and cannot be seen. Rubbing in the straight bone of the jaw, one can naturally draw and move it.
